label: executive of
definition: The first person holds or held an executive office in the second organization or governmental jurisdiction.
scope_notes: Executive constructions overwhelmingly dominate. Corporate and county executive offices both qualify under the same office relation. Candidacy, nomination, legislation and being hired by an executive alone do not establish tenure; direct historical titles and resignation do.

facts.reason: Parsons is repeatedly explicitly an AOL Time Warner executive. The chairman row is a further leadership title and the long leave/say row is not needed.
Kozlowski is directly a Tyco executive; resigning as its executive additionally establishes historical tenure.
Levy is repeatedly Suffolk County executive and is explicitly sworn in as county executive. The nomination/legislator paths alone would not suffice.
McIlvaine is directly called the Mets executive in possessive and noun-compound paths. The hire-by-executive rows may attach a different executive but do not remove the direct role evidence.
Skilling is directly an Enron executive in appositive and relative-clause paths; the co-defendant description also attaches that title to him.
